The structure of Silicon has been successfully retrieved and converted into a LAMMPS data file. Now, we need to prepare a LAMMPS input script for the NPT heating simulation. function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path":"/results/6_Nov_Optimised/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/subtask_false/level_2/brief/silicon_melting_2_trial_0/in.lammps","content":"# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting of Silicon

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

read_data       silicon.data

# Define potential
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Replicate the system
replicate       3 3 3

# Define settings
timestep        0.001
thermo          100

# NPT ensemble
temp_initial    300
temp_final      2500
pressure        0.0

fix             1 all npt temp ${temp_initial} ${temp_final} ${heating_rate} iso ${pressure} ${pressure} 1.0

# Compute MSD
compute         msd all msd
fix             2 all ave/time 1 100 100 c_msd[4] file msd.txt

# Run simulation
run             1000000

# Unfix
unfix           1
unfix           2
"}
